Workloads.name: default-day
Workloads.source: sim DefaultConfig (doc.go): 500 PRs/24h, 5% global broken, fixed 2-min CI; batch 8 / 30s wait from TestExit500PRDay

Workloads.name: mixture-day
Workloads.source: default-day arrivals; synthetic risk mixture 85%@1.5% + 15%@25% (mean 5.0%, matched to DefaultConfig), logit score noise 0.5; lognormal CI median 2m sigma 0.3

Workloads.name: beta-loaded
Workloads.source: synthetic: 800 PRs/24h, Beta(0.4, 7.6) risk (mean 5%), score noise 0.5, lognormal CI median 4m sigma 0.3 (about 80% of serial batch-8 capacity)

Workloads.name: flaky-mixture-day
Workloads.source: mixture-day with 3% flakes (synthetic stress; capacity profiles use 1%)

Workloads.name: agent-burst-depth4
Workloads.source: capacity.AdaptiveWorkload (900/day, 2-min CI, depth 4, 5%) and Profile.Config (batch 8, 5m wait, 50 runners, 1% flakes, timeout 1.5x CI) for one day; Beta(0.5, 9.5) risk (mean 5%), noise 0.5; 60% of PRs in bursts of 25 within 5m (synthetic agent bursts)

Workloads.name: team-slow-depth4
Workloads.source: capacity.Team (20/day for 30 days, 30-min CI, depth 4, 2%) and Profile.Config; synthetic mixture 90%@0.5% + 10%@15.5% (mean 2%), noise 0.5

Strategies.description: (a) production planner as configured by the workload
Strategies.name: baseline

Strategies.description: (b) reuse the latest completed result for an identical tree
Strategies.name: tree-dedupe

Strategies.description: (d, reference) production BatchTargetPassRate 0.8 from the global failure estimate
Strategies.name: global-adaptive

Strategies.description: (d) per-change risk scores size each fresh batch to a 0.8 pass target
Strategies.name: risk-sized

Strategies.description: (e) failing runs stop at 30% of their duration (CI fail-fast); the queue reacts and cancels earlier
Strategies.name: fail-fast
